sessions.name: ccr1-component-publication
sessions.suggested_first_slice: Migrate component-publication's hand-written one-field substitution matrices in `omega-rust/omega/backend/runtime/component-publication/src/tests.rs` (for example `external_stack_provision_rejects_every_one_field_substitution` and its boxed-closure loops) onto `mutation_matrix::custody_field_inventory!` plus `run_one_field_substitution_matrix`, preserving each family's independent checker and every existing rejection fragment. `omega-rust/omega/packages/topology/tests/custody_substitution.rs` with `custody_substitution/request_custody_fields.rs` is the worked shared-driver example; `tests/architecture/custody_mutation_matrix.rs` is the gate the migrated inventories must satisfy.
